title: Saul and the Medium at En-Dor
description: In despair before the battle against the Philistines, King Saul seeks out the medium at En-Dor to summon the deceased prophet Samuel, who predicts the death of Saul and his sons and Israel's defeat.

versions.title: Saul and the Medium at En-Dor
versions.description: In desperation, King Saul visits the medium at En-Dor to summon the deceased Samuel, who prophesies Saul's downfall in battle against the Philistines.
